title: HeadKit storefront theme
description: Customer-owned layout modes in overrides/. Dashboard branding still owns colors, fonts, and corners.

productEnquiry.description: Show the Shopify PDP product-enquiry form. Default true.

cms.description: Store-owned additions to the WordPress placeholder-page list (lib/cms-placeholder-pages.ts). The platform defaults — WooCommerce's cart and my-account — apply either way.

placeholderNotFound.description: Extra bare top-level slugs the catch-all 404s and the sitemap omits. Matched exactly, never as a prefix: 'legal' does not affect 'legal/privacy-policy'.

placeholderRedirects.description: Extra bare top-level slug to root-relative permanent redirect target.

pdp.description: Optional product-detail chrome. Starter defaults omit this.

sizeGuideHref.description: Internal Size Guide CMS path. When set, every PDP shows one Size Guide control as a modal (Complete the set, colour row, size row, or standalone) — including Bundles. Direct visits still render the page.

catalog.description: Optional catalog presentation. Starter defaults omit this — only badge: tags show until a store allowlists more. Collection arrays omit = current first-N / all-roots behaviour.

badgeTags.description: Product tag names or slugs that render as pills on cards and the PDP. Case-insensitive. Tags prefixed badge: always show.

homepageCollections.description: Ordered collection slugs for the homepage category carousel. Omit or empty = first N from the catalog. Array order is display order.

shopCollections.description: Ordered collection slugs for the Shop header carousel. Omit or empty = all root collections. Array order is display order.

maxCardSwatches.description: Colour dots a product card shows before the rest collapse into a "+N" chip. Omit = starter default (10).

copy.description: Optional section strings. Starter omits this — hardcoded titles stay. `{word}` in title uses the heading highlight face.

collectionCardLink.description: Link text under a homepage collection-card title. Omit = title only.

cart.description: Optional hosted-checkout cart drawer extras. Starter omits this. Packaging and gift message are written as cart attributes and show on the Shopify order as Additional details. Velvet example: {"packaging":{"title":"Packaging choice","options":[{"id":"signature-box","title":"The Signature Box","description":"The textured Velvet box, with the signature and the icon cut through the lid, in a colour matched to your towel.","image":""},{"id":"sustainable-box","title":"The Sustainable Box","description":"Your order arrives in a recyclable kraft case, lighter to ship and made to be reused.","image":""}]},"giftMessage":{"label":"Include a complimentary gift message?"}}

image.description: http(s) URL or root-relative path. Empty omits the thumbnail.

sectionCopy.description: Optional SectionHeader strings. Omit each field to keep the starter default. Empty eyebrow or allButton hides that slot.

title.description: Section heading. `{word}` uses the heading highlight face.

eyebrow.description: SectionHeader description slot (Velvet CSS stacks it above the title).

allButton.description: View-all CTA label. Empty string hides the button.

allButtonPath.description: Internal path for the View-all CTA (e.g. /featured, /collections/bundles).
